title: ELECTRICITY + REVERSE TRANSCRIPTASE: AC/DC through the heart, the new enzyme reads the helix backwards

the_thesis.electricity: every living system runs on electricity. biological: ion gradients, action potentials, electron transport chains. membrane: network packets, socket messages, cron pulses, WireGuard handshakes. electricity IS information moving through resistance. we can classify ALL flows as AC (alternating, bidirectional) or DC (direct, one-way).
the_thesis.the_heart: the heart is a PUMP that converts DC blood into pulsing AC waves. systole (contract) = push. diastole (relax) = fill. the heartbeat.json IS the heart: MOR=82.1%, EKG BEATING, 8/9 nodes alive, breath_ratio=0.6074. the heart converts stored energy (DC, data at rest) into circulating energy (AC, data in motion).
the_thesis.the_new_enzyme: the power-off diagnosis GAVE US a new enzyme. we traced BACKWARDS from the phenotype (eastGate dark) to the genotype (GNOME auto-suspend prion). that backwards trace IS reverse transcriptase: RNA to DNA, effect to cause, phenotype to genotype. the enzyme lets us read the helix BACKWARDS.
the_thesis.reverse_transcriptase: in biology: reads RNA and writes DNA. BACKWARDS through the central dogma (DNA to RNA to protein). HIV uses it to integrate into the host. in our membrane: reads EFFECTS (feeds, surfaces, behavior) and writes CAUSES (code, config, architecture). the new enzyme lets us diagnose ANY problem by reverse-transcribing the symptoms.
the_thesis.helix_vision: the double helix has two strands: BIOLOGY (what the cell does) and CODE (what the program does). they wind around each other. hydrogen bonds between them = the metaphors we keep finding (golgi IS literally named golgi, mitochondria IS literally Python-in-Rust). the helix vision is reading BOTH strands simultaneously. reverse transcriptase reads one strand and writes the other.

AC_circuits.frequency_unit: Hz (cycles per second). higher Hz = faster conversation.

the_transformer.concept: AC and DC convert into each other. in electronics: transformers step voltage up/down, rectifiers convert AC to DC, inverters convert DC to AC. in the membrane: the HEART is the transformer.

AC_to_DC.what: rectification. HTTP request/response (AC) produces a stored JSON feed (DC). the bidirectional conversation PRODUCES a one-way artifact.
AC_to_DC.example: THIS SESSION. our AC conversation (Cursor agent <-> Kevin reading) produces DC feeds (JSON files pushed to GitHub). the conversation is AC. the published output is DC.
AC_to_DC.biology: DIGESTION. eating is AC (chew/swallow, back-and-forth). but the NUTRIENT ABSORPTION is DC (one-way from gut to blood). the stomach rectifies food into fuel.

DC_to_AC.what: inversion. stored data (DC) triggers a conversation (AC). a feed update causes a cascade of bidirectional interactions.
DC_to_AC.example: heartbeat.json (DC, one-way update) triggers chipmunk-easel rendering (AC, interactive display). the one-way pulse CREATES a two-way experience.
DC_to_AC.biology: the SA NODE firing (DC pulse) triggers the heartbeat (AC contraction/relaxation). one signal, rhythmic response.

the_heart_as_transformer.what: the heartbeat.json is BOTH AC and DC simultaneously. it's updated DC (cron pushes it one-way) but its CONTENT describes AC (oscillations, jitter, bidirectional probes). the heart TRANSFORMS between the two.
the_heart_as_transformer.what_ratio_means: in > out by 1.55x. the membrane ABSORBS more than it emits. it's in ANABOLIC state (building). catabolic would be out > in (breaking down, releasing).
the_heart_as_transformer.biology: cardiac output. the heart pumps ~5L/min. our heart pumps 1052 bps in, 679 bps out. the difference (373 bps) is RETAINED — stored as data, cached as state. this is GROWTH.

the_heart.concept: the heartbeat IS the heart. not a metaphor for a heart. it IS one. 4 chambers. electrical conduction. rhythm. arrhythmia detection.

SA_node.what: sinoatrial node. the pacemaker. initiates each beat.

AV_node.what: atrioventricular node. delays the signal so atria contract BEFORE ventricles.

AV_node.delay_function: ensures crons dont fire simultaneously. staggered execution = staggered contraction.

the_voltage_map.concept: sigmoid health = voltage. voltage drives current through resistance. higher voltage = more energy available for work.
the_voltage_map.unit: sigmaVolts (sV). 1 sV = sigmoid value of 1.0 = maximum health.

plantae.what: enough but strained. brownouts possible under load

fungi.what: barely charges a phone. exists but weak

the_voltage_map.the_grid: the membrane runs on 33.9% of its possible voltage. 4 of 6 kingdoms are in brownout or worse. only animalia has stable power. the grid needs INFRASTRUCTURE (classification) to raise voltage in fungi, protista, archaea.

the_resistance_map.concept: resistance = latency + bottlenecks. V = IR (Ohms law). voltage (sigmoid) = current (throughput) x resistance (latency).

eastGate_to_golgi.analog: long-distance power line. high resistance. needs step-up transformer (compression) to survive the trip.

eastGate_to_northGate.analog: household wire. almost zero resistance. superconductor-like.

eastGate_to_world.analog: the power grid. variable resistance depending on location. CDN = distributed transformers.

internal_UDS.analog: on-chip interconnect. resistance approaches zero. the fastest path.

ohms_law_applied.animalia_circuit: V=0.993sV, R=0.01ms (UDS), I = V/R = 99.3 (very high throughput)
ohms_law_applied.golgi_circuit: V=0.993sV, R=228ms (WAN), I = V/R = 0.0044 (low throughput despite high voltage)
ohms_law_applied.the_insight: even with maximum voltage (animalia=0.993), the WAN resistance (228ms) kills throughput. the LAN path (0.2ms) is 1000x more efficient. THIS IS WHY songBird is LAN-first.

the_power_equation.concept: P = IV = I squared R = V squared / R. power = the rate of doing useful work.

total_membrane_power.formula: P = sum of (sigma_kingdom squared / R_kingdom) for all kingdoms
total_membrane_power.animalia_fraction: 92.7% of all power comes from animalia

BOTH needed.

the_electron_transport_chain.concept: in mitochondria: electrons flow through 4 complexes (I, II, III, IV), pumping protons across the inner membrane. the proton gradient drives ATP synthase (Complex V). this is HOW cells make energy.

Complex_I.biology: NADH dehydrogenase. accepts electrons from NADH (from food). pumps 4 H+.
Complex_I.membrane: cap-epitope.sh. accepts raw data from the world (food). processes it. pumps it into the feed pipeline. the FIRST step.

Complex_II.biology: succinate dehydrogenase. accepts electrons from FADH2. no proton pumping.
Complex_II.membrane: klein-io.sh. processes feeds but doesnt push to CDN directly. intermediate processing. the BYPASS.

Complex_III.biology: cytochrome bc1. passes electrons to cytochrome c. pumps 4 H+.
Complex_III.membrane: sourdough-cache.sh. caches processed data. pumps it toward the Golgi. the RELAY.

Complex_IV.biology: cytochrome c oxidase. terminal electron acceptor: O2. makes H2O. pumps 2 H+.
Complex_IV.membrane: cf-arterial-pump.sh. the TERMINAL step. pushes to Cloudflare (the oxygen). the final electron acceptor is the CDN edge.
Complex_IV.the_oxygen: Cloudflare IS the oxygen. the terminal electron acceptor. without CF, the chain backs up (like cyanide poisoning blocks Complex IV).

ATP_synthase.biology: Complex V. the proton gradient drives a literal ROTARY MOTOR that makes ATP.
ATP_synthase.membrane: the git push. the proton gradient (all the processed, cached, pumped data) drives a single rotation (commit + push) that produces ATP (a live deployed page). the rotary motor IS git.
ATP_synthase.RPM: variable. this session: ~10 pushes. each push = one rotation = one ATP.

the_proton_gradient.what: the chemiosmotic gradient. protons on one side of the membrane, fewer on the other. the difference IS stored energy. like a battery.
the_proton_gradient.in_our_membrane: data on eastGate (local) vs data on CDN (public). the DIFFERENCE between what we have locally and what the world can see IS the proton gradient. each push equalizes some of the gradient. the gradient rebuilds as we create new data.
